open System
open System.IO
open Grace.Types.Common
open Grace.Types.DirectoryVersion
open Grace.Shared.Utilities
open Grace.Shared.StorageKeys
open NodaTime

/// Fails the disposable source check when the current contract differs from the expected result.
let check name condition = if not condition then failwith name

let repositoryId = Guid.Parse "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
let ownerId = Guid.Parse "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
let organizationId = Guid.Parse "33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"
let timestamp = Instant.FromUtc(2026, 9, 7, 0, 0)

/// Creates a fixed whole-file declaration through Grace's existing constructor.
let whole path size =
    let file = FileVersion.CreateWithHashes path (String.replicate 64 "a") (String.replicate 64 "b") "" true size
    file.CreatedAt <- timestamp
    file

/// Creates a manifest declaration whose complete logical length remains independent of shared blocks.
let manifest address =
    let block = ContentBlock.Create("shared-block", 0L, 20L)
    let value = FileManifest.Create(address, "suite", "hash", 20L, "pool-a", [ block ])
    let file = whole "manifest.txt" 20L
    file.ContentReference <- FileContentReference.FileManifest value
    file

let a = whole "a.txt" 10L
let b = whole "b.txt" 10L
let m1 = manifest "manifest-1"
let m2 = manifest "manifest-2"
let directory = DirectoryVersion()
directory.RepositoryId <- repositoryId
directory.OwnerId <- ownerId
directory.OrganizationId <- organizationId
directory.DirectoryVersionId <- Guid.Parse "44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444"
directory.CreatedAt <- timestamp
directory.Files.AddRange [ a; a; b; m1; m1; m2 ]

/// Adds deterministic metadata to an event serialized by Grace's configured serializer.
let event value =
    { Event = value
      Metadata = { Timestamp = timestamp; CorrelationId = "ops-1045"; Principal = "fixture"; ClientType = None
                   Properties = Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, string>() } }

let original = [| event (Created directory); event (RecursiveSizeSet 999L); event (LogicalDeleted "fixture") |]
let wire = serialize original
let restored = deserialize<DirectoryVersionEvent array> wire
let dto = restored |> Array.fold (fun state item -> DirectoryVersionDto.UpdateDto item state) DirectoryVersionDto.Default
check "retained direct files survive logical deletion" (dto.DeletedAt.IsSome && dto.DirectoryVersion.Files.Count = 6)
check "recursive size is separate" (dto.RecursiveSize = 999L)
check "same hash at different path has different key" (wholeFileContentObjectKey a <> wholeFileContentObjectKey b)
check "duplicate whole file has same key" (wholeFileContentObjectKey a = wholeFileContentObjectKey a)

/// Projects only the identity and declared size needed by the local capture model.
let rows =
    dto.DirectoryVersion.Files
    |> Seq.map (fun file ->
        match file.ContentReference.ReferenceType, file.ContentReference.Manifest with
        | FileContentReferenceType.WholeFileContent, None ->
            {| Scope = string repositoryId; Key = $"whole:{repositoryId}:{wholeFileContentObjectKey file}"; Bytes = file.Size |}
        | FileContentReferenceType.FileManifest, Some value ->
            {| Scope = string repositoryId; Key = $"manifest:{value.StoragePoolId}:{value.ManifestAddress}"; Bytes = value.Size |}
        | _ -> failwith "unsupported content reference")
    |> Seq.toArray
check "six references reduce to four identities and sixty bytes"
    ((rows |> Array.distinctBy _.Key |> Array.sumBy _.Bytes) = 60L)
File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(__SOURCE_DIRECTORY__, "events.json"), wire)
File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(__SOURCE_DIRECTORY__, "rows.json"), serialize rows)
printfn "PASS: Grace event serialization, DTO fold, logical retention, recursive-size separation, whole-file keys, manifest projection (60 bytes, 4 identities)."
